name: Hellish Blizzard

skills.name: Basic
skills.desc: Deals Direct DMG of 120% ATK to a single target.

skills.name: Ultimate
skills.desc: Deals Direct DMG of 160% ATK to all enemies, plus [Ice] DMG to all enemies.

skills.name: Ultra-Ultimate
skills.desc: Deals Direct DMG of 160% > 200% ATK to all enemies, plus [Ice] DMG to all enemies.

skills.name: Passive
skills.desc: On entry: +20% HP to self, +60% [Non-Crit DMG Free], and +60% [DoT Bonus].

skills.name: Extreme Passive
skills.desc: On entry: +20% HP to self, [Non-Crit DMG Free] 60% > 70%, and [DoT Bonus] 60% > 80%.

skills.name: 5★ Passive
skills.desc: On entry: +20% HP to self, [Non-Crit DMG Free] 70% > 80%, and [DoT Bonus] 80% > 100%.

skills.name: Awaken 1 Passive
skills.desc: After any enemy character triggers [Locked], inflicts [Continuous Explosion]. ———- [Continuous Explosion]: Immediately splash to surrounding target, dealing 80% [Locked] DoT

skills.name: Awaken 2 Passive
skills.desc: When battle begins, inflicts 50% ATK of [Locked] to the whole enemy team, lasts for 1 round.

effects.desc: A general positive enhancing effect applies to the character, raising stats or granting benefits (e.g. increasing Hit Rate or damage dealt).
The control state prevents the target from activating Charge, Continuous Charge, Link, and Special attacks.
The effect immediately spreads to surrounding targets, dealing 80% ST over Locked's duration.
Additional damage dealt by critical hits; is often adjusted via [Crit DMG Reduction] to cut down on this addition.
Ice damage effects are added to attacks, dealing them to enemies along with the main attack.

bondList: Fubuki (Hellish Blizzard) + Eyelashes + Mountain Ape + Lily of the Three Section Staff
